entries.title: Isaiah 19:1
segments: ¶The burden against Egypt. Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, And will come into Egypt; The idols of Egypt will totter at His presence, And the heart of Egypt will melt in its midst.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:2
segments: "I will set Egyptians against Egyptians; Everyone will fight against his brother, And everyone against his neighbor, City against city, kingdom against kingdom.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:3
segments: The spirit of Egypt will fail in its midst; I will destroy their counsel, And they will consult the idols and the charmers, The mediums and the sorcerers.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:4
segments: And the Egyptians I will give Into the hand of a cruel master, And a fierce king will rule over them," Says the Lord, the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:5
segments: The waters will fail from the sea, And the river will be wasted and dried up.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:6
segments: The rivers will turn foul; The brooks of defense will be emptied and dried up; The reeds and rushes will wither.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:7
segments: The papyrus reeds by the River, by the mouth of the River, And everything sown by the River, Will wither, be driven away, and be no more.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:8
segments: The fishermen also will mourn; All those will lament who cast hooks into the River, And they will languish who spread nets on the waters.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:9
segments: Moreover those who work in fine flax And those who weave fine fabric will be ashamed;

entries.title: Isaiah 19:10
segments: And its foundations will be broken. All who make wages [will be] troubled of soul.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:11
segments: Surely the princes of Zoan [are] fools; Pharaoh's wise counselors give foolish counsel. How do you say to Pharaoh, "I [am] the son of the wise, The son of ancient kings?"

entries.title: Isaiah 19:12
segments: Where [are] they? Where are your wise men? Let them tell you now, And let them know what the LORD of hosts has purposed against Egypt.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:13
segments: The princes of Zoan have become fools; The princes of Noph are deceived; They have also deluded Egypt, [Those who are] the mainstay of its tribes.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:14
segments: The LORD has mingled a perverse spirit in her midst; And they have caused Egypt to err in all her work, As a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:15
segments: Neither will there be [any] work for Egypt, Which the head or tail, Palm branch or bulrush, may do.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:16
segments: In that day Egypt will be like women, and will be afraid and fear because of the waving of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which He waves over it.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:17
segments: And the land of Judah will be a terror to Egypt; everyone who makes mention of it will be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts which He has determined against it.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:18
segments: ¶In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear by the LORD of hosts; one will be called the City of Destruction.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:19
segments: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:20
segments: And it will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of the oppressors, and He will send them a Savior and a Mighty One, and He will deliver them.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:21
segments: Then the LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day, and will make sacrifice and offering; yes, they will make a vow to the LORD and perform [it].

entries.title: Isaiah 19:22
segments: And the LORD will strike Egypt, He will strike and heal [it]; they will return to the LORD, and He will be entreated by them and heal them.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:23
segments: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian will come into Egypt and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians will serve with the Assyrians.

entries.title: Isaiah 19:24
segments: In that day Israel will be one of three with Egypt and Assyria-a blessing in the midst of the land,

entries.title: Isaiah 19:25
segments: whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, "Blessed [is] Egypt My people, and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance."
